list.text: \f[faceprofElm]Prof. Elm: \bHi, \PN!\nI've been waiting for you!
\f[faceprofElm]\bI need your help with something quite special and mysterious...
\f[faceprofElm]\bIt's this Mysterious Ball. A unique Poké Ball unlike anything we've studied before.
\f[faceprofElm]\bProfessor Oak, Professor Ivy, and I have been researching it for years now, but we've hit a roadblock.
\f[faceprofElm]\bFor some strange reason, it can't be teleported through our usual systems.
\f[faceprofElm]\bWould you be willing to deliver the Mysterious Ball personally to Professor Ivy?
\f[faceprofElm]\bShe's continuing her research at her laboratory in the Orange Islands.
\f[faceprofElm]\bHave you heard of the Orange Islands?
\f[faceprofElm]\bPokémon Trainers go there to participate in the Orange League, but its tropical climate also attracts many tourists.
\f[faceprofElm]\bSo, what do you say? Are you ready for another adventure?
\f[faceprofElm]\bThe mysteries of this Poké Ball and the challenges of the Orange League await you!
\f[faceprofElm]\bExcellent!

then.text: \f[faceprofElm]\bPlease handle it with care. Professor Ivy will be expecting you at her lab.

list.text: \f[faceprofElm]\bTake this as well.

then.text: \f[faceprofElm]\bYou can get the ship in Olivine Port, as you already know.
\f[faceprofElm]\bSafe travels, and I look forward to hearing about your experiences in the Orange Islands!
